name: WeCreat Vision
tagline: AI-assisted enclosed diode with live preview : beginner-friendly smart laser
tldr: WeCreat's enclosed diode laser adds a camera and AI features for material detection and visual preview. Appealing for beginners who want guidance. Core laser performance is comparable to other enclosed diodes : you pay for the smart features.

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Everyday engrave and light cut mix : typical 6 mm basswood in several passes
Integrated cabinet helps contain the beam and everyday smoke versus open-frame diodes
Software on the profile : trial your workflow on scrap before production
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers WeCreat Vision. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Use camera preview for batch placement but still run test cards for new materials : AI presets are starting points, not gospel. LightBurn unlocks more control when you outgrow the stock app.
primaryUse: Smart enclosed diode laser for beginners who want visual guidance and filtered home operation.

faq.question: Is the AI feature actually useful?
faq.answer: For beginners, yes : it speeds up first projects and reduces alignment errors. Pros will likely ignore it and use LightBurn with manual settings.

faq.question: WeCreat vs xTool S1?
faq.answer: Similar enclosed diode category. xTool has a larger community and longer track record. WeCreat competes on AI/camera UX. Choose xTool for ecosystem; WeCreat if the smart preview appeals to you.

mainObjective: AI-guided enclosed engraving for visual, beginner-friendly workflow

editorialDepth.advantages: WeCreat Vision 20W is the versatile hobby / side-business SKU : clean engraving and light wood or leather cuts with comparable benchmarks on Maker Atlas.
editorialDepth.limitations: Not a CO₂ replacement for clear acrylic or heavy thick-stock production.
